name: BBQ Shrimp, Zucchini & Corn over Cheddar Cauliflower Grits

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and cut cauliflower heads into quarters, then trim off and discard leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate cauliflower.

Place cauliflower, broth, polenta, and salt in a large pot. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover and reduce heat to medium-low; cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the mixture has thickened, 20-25 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1183 ml chicken or vegetable broth
¾ cup polenta (cornmeal)
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place tomato sauce, ketchup, Dijon, sugar, vinegar, Worcestershire, and spices in a medium saucepan. Stir and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 7 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
3 tbsp ketchup
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
3 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and medium dice zucchini.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add zucchini and corn to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are lightly browned and softened, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine spices in a large bowl. Add shrimp and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add shrimp to the skillet with the veggies; cook until opaque, about 5 minutes. Pour the sauce into the skillet and toss to combine; remove from heat.
Add cheese and butter to the pot with the cauliflower grits and stir to melt and combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cauliflower grits between plates or bowls. Top with vegetables and shrimp. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
